answer: Duplicating an identity requires re-staking the full bond plus paying the beacon's per-attestation fee, so launching N sybils costs N times the bond and fee, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent stake is locked in a crystal escrow contract tied to a juniper-signed identity, refreshed every epoch via a lagoon-style proof-of-presence beacon. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
